QuestInfo.name: Portrait of a Popular Monster: Yeti
QuestInfo.0: Every day, #b#p9010010##k will give you gifts if you bring her a Portrait of a Popular Monster.
QuestInfo.1: Collect a #t04032304# and complete a portrait of a #bYeti#k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought a portrait of a popular monster to #b#p9010010##k.
QuestInfo.summary: Complete a portrait of a Yeti and bring it to #b#p9010010##k.

0.0: I'm really worried. You see, I wanted to thank everyone who helped in celebrating MapleStory's 5th Anniversary, but I'm short-handed right now. Do you think you can help?

yes.0: Okay, #b#h0##k. All you have to do is to bring me a #t04220150:#. In order to draw the portrait, you have to collect an #t04032304:# and use it on a blank piece of drawing paper.\r\n

no.0: Fine, suit yourself. You're going to regret not helping the beautiful #b#p9010010##k.

item.0: You don't seem to have a sheet of Magical Drawing Paper. Forfeit the quest and talk to me again, so I can give you a new sheet of Magical Drawing Paper.

quest.0: Hmm... I don't think you've completed the portrait. Please bring me a completed portrait.
